source.text: כִּֽי־שָׂנֵ֣א שַׁלַּ֗ח אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְכִסָּ֤ה חָמָס֙ עַל־לְבוּשׁ֔וֹ אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וְנִשְׁמַרְתֶּ֥ם בְּרוּחֲכֶ֖ם וְלֹ֥א תִבְגֹּֽדוּ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: For [he] hates sending away, says Yahweh, the God of Israel, and covering violence over his garment, says Yahweh of hosts. So guard yourselves in your spirit, and do not act faithlessly.

en.L: For [he] hates divorce, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, \q and [one who] covers violence over his garment, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts. \q So take heed to your spirit, and do not act faithlessly.
en.B: For I hate divorce, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, \q and I hate it when a man covers his garment with violence, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies. \q So guard yourselves in your spirit, and do not be unfaithful.
en.R: I hate divorce, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel. \q I hate it when a man stains himself with violence, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies. \q So be careful, and do not be unfaithful.

es.L: Porque [él] odia el repudio, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, \q y [al que] cubre de violencia su vestido, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos. \q Así que {{plural_you:cuiden|cuidad}} {{plural_you:su espíritu|vuestro espíritu}}, y no {{plural_you:sean desleales|seáis desleales}}.
es.B: Porque yo detesto el divorcio, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, \q y detesto que un hombre manche de violencia su ropa, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos. \q Así que {{plural_you:cuídense|cuidaos}} en {{plural_you:su espíritu|vuestro espíritu}}, y no {{plural_you:sean|seáis}} infieles.
es.R: Odio el divorcio, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel. \q Odio que un hombre se manche con violencia, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos. \q Así que {{plural_you:tengan|tened}} cuidado, y no {{plural_you:sean|seáis}} infieles.

fr.L: Car [il] déteste qu’on renvoie [sa femme], dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, \q et [qu’on] couvre de violence son vêtement, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. \q Prenez donc garde à votre esprit, et n’agissez pas avec perfidie.
fr.B: Car je déteste le divorce, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, \q et je déteste qu’un homme recouvre son vêtement de violence, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. \q Veillez donc sur votre esprit, et ne soyez pas infidèles.
fr.R: Je déteste le divorce, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël. \q Je déteste qu’un homme se salisse par la violence, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. \q Faites donc attention, et ne soyez pas infidèles.

sw.L: Kwa maana [yeye] huchukia kumfukuza [mke], asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, \q na [mtu] kulifunika vazi lake kwa jeuri, \q asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi. \q Basi jihadharini katika roho zenu, wala msitende kwa hila.
sw.B: Kwa maana ninachukia talaka, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, \q na ninachukia mtu anapolifunika vazi lake kwa ukatili, \q asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi. \q Basi jilindeni katika roho zenu, wala msikose uaminifu.
sw.R: Ninachukia talaka, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli. \q Ninachukia mtu anapojichafua kwa ukatili, \q anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi. \q Basi jihadharini, wala msikose uaminifu.

vi.L: Vì [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}] ghét việc đuổi [vợ] đi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên phán, \q và [việc] lấy sự hung bạo che áo mình, \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán. \q Vậy hãy giữ lấy tâm linh mình, và đừng phản bội.
vi.B: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ghét sự ly dị, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên phán, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ghét khi một người lấy sự hung bạo phủ lên áo mình, \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán. \q Vậy hãy giữ gìn tâm linh mình, và đừng bất trung.
vi.R: Ta ghét sự ly dị, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên phán. \q Ta ghét khi một người làm ô uế mình bằng sự hung bạo, \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán. \q Vậy hãy cẩn thận, và đừng bất trung.

ko.L: [그는] 내보내는 것을 미워한다. 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 또 자기 옷을 폭력으로 덮는 것을 [미워한다]. \q 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 그러므로 너희 영을 조심하고, 신의를 저버리지 말아라.
ko.B: 나는 이혼을 미워한다. 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 남자가 폭력으로 자기 옷을 덮는 것도 나는 미워한다. \q 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 그러므로 너희 영을 잘 지키고, 신의를 저버리지 말아라.
ko.R: 나는 이혼을 미워한다. 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 남자가 폭력으로 자기를 더럽히는 것도 미워한다. \q 하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 그러니 조심하여 배신하지 말아라.

decisions.choice: For he hates divorce, says the LORD: the LORD hates divorce
alternatives: the man who hates and divorces covers his garment with violence
if you hate her, send her away
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is hard. Read as here, "he hates" has the LORD as its subject, as the words "says the LORD" suggest, and the LORD declares that he hates divorce and the violence done with it. The main other reading takes the man as the subject of both verbs: "the one who hates and divorces covers his garment with violence", that is, a man who divorces his wife out of dislike does her violence. The Greek translation and one of the Qumran scrolls are generally said to read "if you hate her, send her away", which would permit divorce and goes against the rest of the passage. All the readings agree that the LORD condemns the treachery of verses 14-15.

decisions.choice: covers his garment with violence: violence clings to him like a stain on his clothes
alternatives: wrongs the wife he took under his garment
decisions.reason: Wrongdoing worn like clothing is a common picture (Psalm 73:6; 109:18). A man spread his garment over a woman as a sign of marriage (Ruth 3:9; Ezekiel 16:8), so some read "garment" as the wife herself, wronged by her husband.

decisions.choice: divorce: sending a wife away
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for divorce in Deuteronomy 24:1-4: a man "sends her out of his house". |

decisions.choice: I hate (B, R); [he] hates (L)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "he hates" within words the LORD speaks. Literal keeps the third person with brackets, as set for this verse; Balanced and Readable say "I hate", because the LORD is the speaker (m1). Readable says "stains himself with violence" for "covers his garment with violence", the first sense in m2.

decisions.choice: "kumfukuza [mke]" (L), "talaka" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew "sending away", the word for divorce in Deuteronomy 24:1-4 (m3); Balanced and Readable use the ordinary word for divorce.

records.literal_gloss: You have wearied Yahweh with your words. And you say, In what have we wearied [him]? In your saying, Everyone who does evil [is] good in [the] eyes of Yahweh, and in them he delights; or, Where [is] the God of justice?

en.L: You have wearied {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with your words. \q But you say, "How have we wearied {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}?" \q By your saying, "Everyone who does evil is good in the eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} delights in them," \q or else, "Where is the God of justice?"
en.B: You have wearied {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with your words. \q Yet you ask, "In what way have we wearied {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}?" \q When you say, "All who do evil are good in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s sight, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is pleased with them," \q or by asking, "Where is the God of justice?"
en.R: You have made {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} tired of listening to you. \q But you ask, "How have we made {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} tired?" \q You say, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} thinks that everyone who does evil is good, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is happy with them." \q Or you ask, "Where is the God who judges fairly?"

es.L: {{plural_you:Han cansado|Habéis cansado}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} con {{plural_you:sus palabras|vuestras palabras}}. \q Pero {{plural_you:ustedes dicen|vosotros decís}}: «¿En qué {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} hemos cansado?» \q En que {{plural_you:dicen|decís}}: «Todo el que hace el mal es bueno a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y en ellos {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se complace», \q o bien: «¿Dónde está el Dios de la justicia?»
es.B: {{plural_you:Han cansado|Habéis cansado}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} con {{plural_you:sus palabras|vuestras palabras}}. \q Y aun así {{plural_you:ustedes preguntan|vosotros preguntáis}}: «¿De qué manera {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} hemos cansado?» \q Cuando {{plural_you:dicen|decís}}: «Todos los que hacen el mal son buenos a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se agrada de ellos», \q o cuando {{plural_you:preguntan|preguntáis}}: «¿Dónde está el Dios de la justicia?»
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes han cansado|Vosotros habéis cansado}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} de tanto hablar. \q Pero {{plural_you:ustedes preguntan|vosotros preguntáis}}: «¿Cómo {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} hemos cansado?» \q {{plural_you:Dicen|Decís}}: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} piensa que todo el que hace el mal es bueno, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} está contento con ellos». \q O {{plural_you:preguntan|preguntáis}}: «¿Dónde está el Dios que juzga con justicia?»

fr.L: Vous avez fatigué {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} par vos paroles. \q Mais vous dites : « En quoi {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}avons-nous fatigué ? » \q En disant : « Quiconque fait le mal est bon aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et c’est en eux qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} prend plaisir », \q ou bien : « Où est le Dieu de la justice ? »
fr.B: Vous avez lassé {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} par vos paroles. \q Et vous demandez : « En quoi {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}avons-nous lassé ? » \q Quand vous dites : « Tous ceux qui font le mal sont bons aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} prend plaisir en eux », \q ou quand vous demandez : « Où est le Dieu de la justice ? »
fr.R: Vous avez fatigué {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} à force de parler. \q Mais vous demandez : « Comment {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}avons-nous fatigué ? » \q Vous dites : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} pense que tous ceux qui font le mal sont bons, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est content d’eux. » \q Ou vous demandez : « Où est le Dieu qui juge avec équité ? »

sw.L: Mmemchosha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa maneno yenu. \q Nanyi mwasema, "Tumemchosha kwa namna gani?" \q Kwa kusema kwenu, "Kila atendaye maovu ni mwema machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} hupendezwa nao," \q au, "Yuko wapi Mungu wa hukumu?"
sw.B: Mmemchosha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa maneno yenu. \q Lakini mnauliza, "Tumemchosha kwa namna gani?" \q Mnaposema, "Wote watendao maovu ni wema machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} anapendezwa nao," \q au mnapouliza, "Yuko wapi Mungu wa haki?"
sw.R: Mmemchosha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa maneno yenu mengi. \q Lakini mnauliza, "Tumemchosha kwa jinsi gani?" \q Mnasema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anaona kwamba kila mtu atendaye maovu ni mwema, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} anafurahishwa nao." \q Au mnauliza, "Yuko wapi Mungu anayehukumu kwa haki?"

vi.L: Các ngươi đã làm cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mệt mỏi bởi lời nói của các ngươi. \q Nhưng các ngươi nói: "Chúng tôi đã làm {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mệt mỏi ở chỗ nào?" \q Ấy là khi các ngươi nói: "Mọi kẻ làm ác đều tốt dưới mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vui thích nơi chúng," \q hoặc: "Đức Chúa Trời của công lý ở đâu?"
vi.B: Các ngươi đã làm cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mệt mỏi vì lời nói của mình. \q Thế mà các ngươi hỏi: "Chúng tôi đã làm {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mệt mỏi bằng cách nào?" \q Ấy là khi các ngươi nói: "Mọi kẻ làm ác đều tốt trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hài lòng về chúng," \q hoặc khi hỏi: "Đức Chúa Trời của công lý ở đâu?"
vi.R: Các ngươi đã làm cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} chán nghe các ngươi. \q Thế mà các ngươi hỏi: "Chúng tôi đã làm {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chán bằng cách nào?" \q Các ngươi nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho rằng mọi kẻ làm ác đều tốt, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vui lòng với chúng." \q Hoặc các ngươi hỏi: "Đức Chúa Trời công minh ở đâu?"

ko.L: 너희가 너희 말로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 지치게 하였다. \q 그런데 너희는 "저희가 무엇으로 그분을 지치게 하였습니까?" 하고 말한다. \q 너희가 "악을 행하는 자는 모두 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 좋으며, 그분께서 그들을 기뻐하신다" 하고, \q 또 "정의의 하나님은 어디 계시냐?" 하고 말하는 것으로 [지치게 하였다].
ko.B: 너희는 말로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 지치게 하였다. \q 그런데도 너희는 "저희가 어떻게 그분을 지치게 하였습니까?" 하고 묻는다. \q 너희가 "악을 행하는 자는 다 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 좋으며, 그분께서는 그들을 기뻐하신다" 하고 말하거나, \q "정의의 하나님은 어디 계시냐?" 하고 묻기 때문이다.
ko.R: 너희가 하는 말에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 지치셨다. \q 그런데 너희는 "저희가 어떻게 그분을 지치시게 하였습니까?" 하고 묻는다. \q 너희는 "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 악한 일을 하는 사람도 다 좋게 보시고, 그들을 기뻐하신다" 하고 말한다. \q 또 "공정하게 심판하시는 하나님은 어디 계시냐?" 하고 묻는다.

decisions.choice: you have wearied the LORD: you have tried his patience
decisions.reason: Isaiah 43:24 has the LORD say, "you have wearied me with your iniquities". Here it is their words that weary him. |

decisions.choice: "Where is the God of justice?": the people doubt that God judges
decisions.reason: The people see the wicked prosper and conclude that God approves of them, or that he does not care. The dispute runs on into 3:1-5, where the LORD answers: he will come to his temple to judge. |

decisions.choice: the God of justice: the God who judges rightly
decisions.reason: "The LORD is a God of justice" (Isaiah 30:18). |

decisions.choice: wearied him; delights in them (L), pleased (B), happy (R)
decisions.reason: The people's words are in double quotes, and their pronouns for God take the deity_pronoun setting. Readable says "made the LORD tired of listening" for "wearied the LORD with your words". |
